business_summary: The Pacific Securities Co., Ltd engages in the securities business in China. It operates through Securities brokerage business, Credit business, Securities investment business, Investment banking operations, Asset management business, and other segments. The company provides securities brokerage, securities investment consulting, securities investment fund sales, agency sales of financial products, margin trading, and IB introduction activities; margin financing and securities lending business, and stock pledge repurchase business; equity investment and fixed income investment business; stock underwriting and sponsorship business, enterprise bonds, corporate bonds, local government bonds and underwriting business, mergers and acquisitions, corporate restructuring, etc.; as well as collective and single asset management business, asset securitization, and investment consulting business. It also offers private equity funds and alternative investment business. The Pacific Securities Co., Ltd was incorporated in 2004 and is headquartered in Kunming, China.
business_summary_ko: 태평양증권주식회사는 중국에서 증권업을 영위하고 있습니다. 증권 중개업, 신용업, 증권 투자업, 투자 은행업, 자산 관리업 및 기타 부문을 통해 운영됩니다. 증권중개, 증권투자컨설팅, 증권투자펀드 판매, 금융상품 대행, 마진거래, IB 도입 등의 활동을 제공합니다. 마진금융업, 증권대여업, 주식담보환매입업, 지분 투자 및 채권 투자 사업; 주식 인수 및 후원업, 회사채, 회사채, 지방채 및 인수업, 인수합병, 기업 구조조정 등 집합자산 및 단일자산관리사업, 자산유동화사업, 투자컨설팅사업 등을 운영하고 있습니다. 또한 사모펀드와 대체투자 사업도 제공하고 있습니다. Pacific Securities Co., Ltd는 2004년에 설립되었으며 중국 쿤밍에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
